Jasper Rabbit has a problem: he is NOT doing well in school. His spelling tests? Disasters. His math quizzes? Frightening to behold. But one day, he finds a crayon lying in the gutter. Purple. And Jasper must find a way to get rid of it before it takes over his life. The only problem? The creepy crayon will not leave.
